description: The RECORD KEY ordering contract, and the last of this folder's normal completions. app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl:29-33 declares three clauses that together fix the delivery sequence: ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED makes CARDFILE a KSDS rather than a flat file, ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL makes the READ at :93 a bare read that positions by nothing, and RECORD KEY IS FD-CARD-NUM names the key it walks - the leading sixteen bytes, per the FD split FD-CARD-NUM PIC X(16) plus FD-CARD-DATA PIC X(134) at :39-40, which is CVACT02Y's CARD-NUM X(16) at one-based offsets 1-16. A sequential READ of a KSDS therefore walks the KEY SEQUENCE, ascending, and not the order in which the records were loaded. That is a real parity risk rather than a theoretical one: a translation backed by an insertion-ordered list, a hash map or a directory listing would satisfy every other case in this folder and diverge only here, because app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt is itself already sorted ascending on CARD-NUM - verified - so for every other case file order and key order coincide and the distinction is invisible. These three records make the distinction legible from the data alone: the keys 0500024453765740 < 0683586198171516 < 0923877193247330 ascend strictly while their CARD-ACCT-IDs run 00000000050, 00000000027, 00000000002 - strictly downwards - so the sequence can only be keyed on CARD-NUM and on nothing else. AUTHORING FORM: Form B, ascending in and ascending out, because the frozen harness seeds in insertion order and cannot express Form A's contradiction. ParityHarness.seed returns an insertion-ordered map and sorts nothing; CBACT02CParityTest.readSequence walks the seeded rows by index; and the guard everyRecordLineIsASeededRowInFileOrder requires, of all twenty cases, that the displayed lines be exactly the leading seeded rows in seeded order, naming a transposed pair as a break. Supplying the rows descending while expecting them ascending would therefore fail by construction of the harness rather than by any fault of the translation, and a case that can never reach a zero diff would leave the module permanently incomplete. Key ordering is consequently asserted here BY CONSTRUCTION and by contradiction nowhere: the rows are declared inline, explicitly in key sequence, rather than inherited from the fixture's physical order as case06's fixture slice does. The production path corroborates the reading - AccountBalanceReaderJob opens through CardRepository.openBrowse(LOWEST_CARD_NUMBER_KEY, FORWARD), sixteen spaces being the lowest key any CARD-NUM can collate above, and BrowseDirection.FORWARD is defined as ascending key order walked with readNext. STATUS SEQUENCE: openBrowse reports '00' - the response-reporting form, because :121 tests the OPEN - then readNext reports '00' three times, the fourth readNext reports '10', which :98 turns into APPL-RESULT 16 and :108 into END-OF-FILE 'Y', and endBrowse reports '00' so :139 takes its first arm and :85 is reached. LINE ARITHMETIC, 1 + 3 + 1 = 5: the 38-character banner from :71, one 150-character image per record from :78 - exactly one, because the second DISPLAY CARD-RECORD inside 1000-CARDFILE-GET-NEXT is commented out at :96 - and the 36-character banner from :85, with RETURN-CODE 0 from GOBACK at :87. Each image is a fixture row byte for byte, including CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE X(10) at 81-90, misspelled in app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy:9 and left misspelled here, and the trailing FILLER X(59) at 92-150 emitted as fifty-nine spaces, so the record measures 150 and not 91. Every byte is US-ASCII, named explicitly and never taken from the platform default. The program opens CARDFILE INPUT at :120 and contains no WRITE, REWRITE or DELETE, so expectedWrites and expectedFinalState are both empty and that emptiness positively asserts that nothing was written. NAMING DIVERGENCE, rule R1: the unit is account.AccountBalanceReaderJob - Account-named, in the account package - while CBACT02C reads the CARD file and computes no balance; the name comes from the plan and the behaviour from the source. Driven at tasklet level through execute(SysoutSink), with no JobLauncher and no HTTP in the path. PROVENANCE: statically derived by structured reading of app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl, cross-checked against app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy, app/jcl/READCARD.jcl STEP05 - which declares no PARM, hence the empty jobParameters - and the real app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt; never captured from a live COBOL run, which eight independently verified blockers make impossible in this environment, and escalated as risk R-A rather than absorbed silently.
